goal: Make the portfolio beautiful and immediately legible by turning each core project into a roadmap-native visual journey: North Star → achieved → NOW → next biggest win → later.
constraints: Keep all core missions visible together.
Keep secondary experiments accessible without equal visual weight.
Never present derived roadmap guesses as durable truth.
done_when: Seven core missions have durable roadmap contracts.
Core projects are understandable without opening detail.
The next biggest win is obvious per project.
Secondary and quiet projects use progressive disclosure.
CI builds a public-safe snapshot and protects the information hierarchy.
uncertainties: Public Pages intentionally still excludes private projects; the private owner view remains a later mission.
next_step: Merge PR #16 and verify the fresh GitHub Pages deployment serves v0.6.
